---
title: "Lightning Talk"
---

We invite all first-year PGRs an opportunity to present a lightning talk: your presentation should last around 3 minutes, and will be followed by 2 minutes of Q&A. This could be a brief introduction to yourself or some initial research ideas! The floor is yours, and it's a great opportunity to introduce yourself to your peers in a fun, relaxed setting.

If you would like to use some slides or a visual background (this is optional), email the materials to kwft0322\@leeds.ac.uk by **23rd October 2026**.
